easy:mcq:1.stem: In a random sample, $70$ out of $100$ students prefer later school start times. The margin of error is $10$ percentage points. What is the lower end of the estimated interval?

distractorNotes.A: A sign error: the size is right but the sign is wrong.
distractorNotes.B: An arithmetic slip: redo the last computation carefully.
distractorNotes.D: An arithmetic slip: redo the last computation carefully.

solution: The sample estimate is $70\%$. Subtract the margin of error for the lower end.
$70\% - 10$ percentage points $= 60\%$.
The interval's lower end is 60%. The margin describes sampling uncertainty; it is not a guarantee about every student.
